failure_mode: Pair-level resources may not form target-wise screening pools.
v8_evidence: SMRTnet official CV has independent ligand-based splits but zero >=20 target-wise pools; DeepRNA-DTI gives partial internal pools only for the available unseen-compound table.
paper_use: Motivates explicit resource-suitability checks before claiming a target-wise screening benchmark.

failure_mode: Target-wise ranking can be saturated by ligand-only priors.
v8_evidence: In ROBIN molecule perturbation, RNAsmol and strong ligand-only baselines all place the first hit at rank 1 for nearly all >=50 pools.
paper_use: Prevents overclaiming early-hit gains and clarifies why molecule perturbation is a saturation diagnostic.

failure_mode: Chemical similarity does not guarantee label transfer under target/network perturbation.
v8_evidence: Network perturbation has near-identical chemistry to training compounds but much weaker nearest-neighbor label agreement; RNAsmol gains more in low-agreement pools.
paper_use: Supports the offensive low-cost claim: useful protocols can stress target-context effects without RNA 3D.
